note: SR10 allowlist (design K-D21 draft). A difference passes only on an entry with status accepted that matches kind, role (or *), item (exact, or a prefix when match is prefix), the attribute for a label key, and covers every missing language. Every entry is proposed until the owner marks it accepted; --sr10-accept-proposed previews them. Not allowlisted on purpose (material): Python without db.client.operation.duration; Go/Python/Node.js http.client.request.duration without error.type; .NET db.client.operation.duration without db.namespace / db.operation.name / error.type. Status needs-row: the difference is real or needs a gaps row first; it never passes, also not in a preview. Round 2 (2026-11-26): the nine worker span-metrics entries (former 121-129) were removed as a window artefact (only the Go worker drove the api in the window).
